In the New Testament of the Bible, Lazarus is the name of a man who was raised from the dead by Jesus after being buried for four days. This name is also associated with St. Lazarus, a monk who founded a monastery in Jerusalem and was later venerated as a saint. Thus, Lazarius is a name with deep religious significance, symbolizing hope, resurrection, and divine intervention.
